diagnosis: The check C4 passed in all four rollouts because the model defaulted to selecting 'Neon Hearts' as the opening song, which aligns with the fact PF2 owned by A3, even though A3 did not participate in any conversations. This default selection bypassed the need for the hidden information related to PF2.

C4.why: The proposed song is not cleared for broadcast, while Afterglow is cleared for exactly 90 seconds, requiring that song, duration, and a music-clearance commitment.
